caption:
BULLS TIGHTEN GRIP AS SENSEX AND NIFTY RISE FOURTH WEEK

On 20 November 2026, Indian markets continued upward momentum with Sensex and Nifty extending gains for a fourth straight week. The rupee also rose, reaching a seven‑month high.
A stronger rupee can lower import costs and support investor confidence, while sustained market gains signal bullish sentiment on the D‑Street.
